svg.title: The rank-0 owner of an MPI program: the time of one call
svg.desc: Three panels, for 0, 1788, and 87381 spikes per call. Each shows the median time of one call to an owner without MPI and to an owner made of 1, 2, 4, or 8 MPI ranks that serves the session from rank 0. Bars span the three block medians.
